scope.description: Four subtests on a one-voter cluster built by MakeCluster(1): absent_server and control_present_server call AddVoter for a second server that is either unwired and not running or running beforehand, and absent_server_nonvoter and present_server_nonvoter make the same calls through AddNonvoter. Each case records the configuration entry's commit status, samples the node's state, term, commit and last index every 25 ms for 1500 ms, makes a bounded client write, attempts two bounded repairs (RemoveServer and AddNonvoter for the named server), samples the node every 50 ms for a further three seconds, and then, in the absent cases, starts the named server and records whether the cluster recovers.
assumptions: AddNonvoter is the staged alternative the library still supports, because a non-voter receives log entries without counting for the configuration's quorum.
The two forms of the call differ only in the suffrage the named server receives; the rest of the staging is identical.
Bootstrap a single voter and grow it is the sequence BootstrapCluster's documentation recommends.
In-memory LoopbackTransport delivers RPCs in-process without loss.
excluded: No production code is modified and no fault is injected.
No offline recovery or restart is performed.

basis.prefix: Each subtest prints growth_before, growth_window, growth_write_attempt, growth_api_repair_attempt and growth_recovery; the case is identified by mode (absent_server, control_present_server, absent_server_nonvoter, present_server_nonvoter).

before.description: Two subtests, absent_server and control_present_server, on a one-voter cluster built by MakeCluster(1), calling the public AddVoter for a second server that is either unwired and not running or running beforehand. Each case records the configuration entry's commit status, samples state, term, commit and last index every 25 ms for 1500 ms, makes a bounded client write, then makes two bounded repair attempts on the same node (RemoveServer for the named server and AddNonvoter for it) and finally samples the node every 50 ms for three seconds, before the absent case starts the named server and both cases record whether the cluster recovers.
assumptions: Removing the absent server and replacing it with a non-voter are the two natural in-process attempts to undo the growth step, since a non-voter does not count for quorum.
Each repair attempt is bounded by a timer so that a future which never completes cannot hang the harness.
Bootstrap a single voter and grow it with AddVoter is the sequence BootstrapCluster's documentation recommends.
In-memory LoopbackTransport delivers RPCs in-process without loss, so a refused call reflects the library's own answer.
excluded: No production code is modified and no fault is injected.
No offline recovery (RecoverCluster) and no restart are performed, so the manual recovery route stays unexecuted.

prefix.before: The growth subtests print growth_before, growth_window, growth_write_attempt, the new growth_api_repair_attempt (remove_server_error, add_nonvoter_error, unrepaired_state_samples, unrepaired_term_samples, unrepaired_commit_samples over three seconds, and final state, term and commit) and growth_recovery.

revision_reason: Same investigation and growth staging, extended with AddNonvoter variants of the absent and present cases so that the staged alternative recorded as counterevidence is executed rather than assumed; the case names carry the distinction (absent_server versus absent_server_nonvoter, control_present_server versus present_server_nonvoter).
